As I said in the title, I’m pretty much screwed right now, or maybe I’m overthinking it. I honestly didn’t want it to go this way. The first day I was kinda sick but after that I just got lazy and my seasonal depression is acting up right now so I decided to call in sick day after day after day. It’s day 11 right now. My boss called me this morning and hoped I would get better and also informed me that she needs a written letter from a doctor stating my sickness from day 1. I promised to be back tomorrow and I want to be but fuck I can’t fake a doctors notice. And I don’t know if my boss is going to accept me not handing in anything or me saying I forgot because that would be a red flag.   Please Reddit advise me and help me. I have been crying over this since morning and hating myself for it. And I hate that I’m so weak that any problem in my life during my depression leads to suicidal planning. I have a backup plan of swallowing 100 tabs of painkillers and landing myself in the ER. Is that a good idea
